case_name: Sushil Kumar & Anr vs Anita Kumari
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Complainant filed a complaint seeking directions to restrain respondents from committing domestic violence, compensation, maintenance, and sufficient space in the household. The complainant resides with her son in a single room in a shared household. Respondents started harassing the complainant.

legal_principles.principle: The power under Article 227 of the Constitution of India is correctional to set right grave dereliction of duty, flagrant abuse or violation of the fundamental principle of law or justice.
cited_cases: Garment Craft v. Prakash Chand Goel, (2022) 4 SCC 181
keywords: fundamental principle of law or justice

legal_principles.principle: The High Court exercising supervisory jurisdiction does not act as a court of first appeal.
legal_principles.held: ...does not act as a court of first appeal to re-examine the evidence and re-weigh the probabilities.
cited_cases: Prabha Tyagi vs. Kamlesh Devi, (2022) 5 SCC 123

outcome.final_order: The order passed by the Trial Court was upheld, dismissing the appeal filed by the petitioners.
